name: Mullaitivu Beach
description: Mullaitivu Beach, nestled along the rugged coastline of Mullaitivu district, offers pristine sandy shores and crystal-clear waters perfect for swimming and sunbathing. Its serene beauty and relative isolation make it a hidden gem for nature lovers and those seeking a peaceful retreat.

name: Kokkilai Beach (Black Sand)
description: Kokkilai Beach, also known as Black Sand Beach, is a unique black sand stretch along the Mullaitivu coast in Sri Lanka. Known for its striking black sands, the beach attracts visitors seeking sunbathing and swimming. The area's black sand is believed to be formed by volcanic activity, though the exact geological formation remains a subject of local legend and scientific debate. Photographers flock here to capture the mesmerizing contrast of black sand and turquoise waters, making Kokkilai Beach a popular spot for both leisure and photography enthusiasts.

name: Nayaru Beach
description: Nayaru Beach, nestled in Mullaitivu, offers a serene lagoon-side experience perfect for swimming and snorkeling amidst vibrant marine life. Historically significant as a small fishing village, Nayaru has seen growth over recent decades, becoming a popular spot for tourists seeking tranquility and natural beauty. Its calm waters and clear visibility make it ideal for those interested in underwater exploration. Visitors can relax on the beach, soak up the sun, and perhaps catch glimpses of local culture through friendly interactions with the community.
monsoon_note: Rough seas Oct-Jan (Maha monsoon); best Apr-Sep
